# Scripts

<!-- Generated by build_readme.py from each script's header. Do not edit by hand. -->

Command-line tools, one folder per topic. Python scripts run with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and declare their own dependencies inline, so there is nothing to install first. Run everything from the repository root.

## books

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`books/goodreads_fetch.py`](books/goodreads_fetch.py) | Goodreads list / shelf fetcher |

`books/goodreads_fetch.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/books/goodreads_fetch.py                       # urls.txt -> goodreads-out/
uv run scripts/books/goodreads_fetch.py --format csv          # CSV only
uv run scripts/books/goodreads_fetch.py --urls my.txt --out books --delay 5
```

## cosmos

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`cosmos/cosmos-collections.js`](cosmos/cosmos-collections.js) | Cosmos.so collections scraper — paste into the DevTools Console. |
| [`cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs`](cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs) | Checklist runner for the Cosmos scrapers. |
| [`cosmos/cosmos-scraper.js`](cosmos/cosmos-scraper.js) | Cosmos.so collection scraper — paste into the DevTools Console on a collection page (e.g. https://www.cosmos.so/&lt;user&gt;/&lt;collection&gt;). |
| [`cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py`](cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py) | Cosmos.so scraper |

`cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs`

```bash
node scripts/cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs [checklist.md] [--force] [--only <substring>]
```

`cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py                 # reads cosmos-urls.txt
uv run scripts/cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py my-links.txt    # or any file
uv run scripts/cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py --force         # re-scrape everything
```

## discord

## raindrop

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`raindrop/classify_by_rules.py`](raindrop/classify_by_rules.py) | sort a Raindrop bookmark dump into buckets with a JSON rules file and print move batches |
| [`raindrop/extract_bookmarks.py`](raindrop/extract_bookmarks.py) | save Raindrop find_bookmarks results from a Claude Code session transcript as JSON |
| [`raindrop/move_batches.py`](raindrop/move_batches.py) | turn {bucket: [bookmark ids]} into update_bookmarks calls of at most 150 IDs |
| [`raindrop/profile_bookmarks.py`](raindrop/profile_bookmarks.py) | count a Raindrop bookmark dump by tag, domain and link shape |
| [`raindrop/tiktok_by_upload_date.py`](raindrop/tiktok_by_upload_date.py) | bucket TikTok video bookmarks by the upload date hidden in the video ID |
| [`raindrop/wiki_count_by_collection.py`](raindrop/wiki_count_by_collection.py) | rank Raindrop collections by how many Wikipedia bookmarks they hold |

`raindrop/classify_by_rules.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/raindrop/classify_by_rules.py bookmarks.json rules/books_misc.json            # counts + leftovers
uv run scripts/raindrop/classify_by_rules.py bookmarks.json rules/books_misc.json --ops      # move batches as JSON lines
```

`raindrop/extract_bookmarks.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/raindrop/extract_bookmarks.py TRANSCRIPT.jsonl 75935771 -o bookmarks.json
uv run scripts/raindrop/extract_bookmarks.py TRANSCRIPT.jsonl 0 -o everything.json
```

`raindrop/move_batches.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/raindrop/move_batches.py buckets.json --map collections.json
```

`raindrop/profile_bookmarks.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/raindrop/profile_bookmarks.py bookmarks.json
uv run scripts/raindrop/profile_bookmarks.py bookmarks.json --top 40
```

`raindrop/tiktok_by_upload_date.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/raindrop/tiktok_by_upload_date.py videos.json                       # counts per period
uv run scripts/raindrop/tiktok_by_upload_date.py videos.json --map ids.json --ops  # move batches
```

`raindrop/wiki_count_by_collection.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/raindrop/wiki_count_by_collection.py everything.json
uv run scripts/raindrop/wiki_count_by_collection.py everything.json --all-matches
```

## tiktok

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`tiktok/tiktok_dump.py`](tiktok/tiktok_dump.py) | get ALL the metadata for TikTok links with gallery-dl, without downloading, into JSON + CSV + theme batches |

`tiktok/tiktok_dump.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/tiktok/tiktok_dump.py videos.json                         # -> tiktok-dump.json + .csv
uv run scripts/tiktok/tiktok_dump.py urls.txt -o cats --by category --min 5
uv run scripts/tiktok/tiktok_dump.py videos.json --retry --workers 4
uv run --with gallery-dl gallery-dl -i batches/Pets.txt -d downloads/Pets   # download one theme later
```

## wikimedia

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`wikimedia/sort_markdown.py`](wikimedia/sort_markdown.py) | sort wiki_to_markdown.py's .md files into folder/subfolder by their front-matter categories |
| [`wikimedia/wiki_info.py`](wikimedia/wiki_info.py) | Wikipedia URLs -&gt; title, url, Wikidata Q-number, AutoDesc description. |
| [`wikimedia/wiki_to_markdown.py`](wikimedia/wiki_to_markdown.py) | pull full Wikimedia articles into clean, frontmatter-rich Obsidian-safe markdown files. |
| [`wikimedia/wp_tags.py`](wikimedia/wp_tags.py) | List every tag on a WordPress site (via its REST API), no posts fetched. |

`wikimedia/sort_markdown.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/wikimedia/sort_markdown.py corpus                 # dry run: show the plan
uv run scripts/wikimedia/sort_markdown.py corpus --apply         # move the files
uv run scripts/wikimedia/sort_markdown.py corpus --by first --depth 1 --apply
uv run scripts/wikimedia/sort_markdown.py corpus --min 3 --skip "^Plays? " --apply
uv run scripts/wikimedia/sort_markdown.py --undo sort-moves-2026-11-13_120000.csv
```

`wikimedia/wiki_info.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py                       # reads ./urls.txt, writes ./wiki-info.csv
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --input links.csv --column link --output out.csv
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --mode short          # short AutoDesc descriptions
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --md notes.md         # also append a Markdown file
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --no-desc             # title/url/Q only, no AutoDesc calls
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --force               # redo URLs already in the output
```

`wikimedia/wiki_to_markdown.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_to_markdown.py                  # reads ./urls.txt, writes ./corpus/
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_to_markdown.py --input other.txt --output out_dir
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_to_markdown.py --force          # re-download even if file exists
```

`wikimedia/wp_tags.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wp_tags.py https://longreads.com
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wp_tags.py https://longreads.com --max-pages 2   # quick test
```
